messages:
evan: I'm opening a tiny PR to clarify how billing tiers map to metering granularity and to add sample SDK snippets for reading quota headers from responses. Need a quick spec on header names + exact dashboard link to include.

maya: Nice. Can we use `x-redwood-quota` (JSON blob) and `x-redwood-quota-remaining` (scalar) so apps can choose convenience vs detail?

raja: Prefer explicit names: `X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining` and `X-Redwood-Quota-Window` (seconds left). If we return a compact `x-redwood-quota` JSON, call it out as "machine-friendly" only.

jen: Also add a short advisory: "do not derive billing from client-side token counts when batching is enabled". Point people at the metering docs panel.

ev an: Updated draft to include both scalar headers and the JSON header. Added wording: "Prefer headers for low-latency checks; use /usage for full billing fields."

olivia: For the dashboard link use: https://console.redwood.ai/observe/billing/usage-summary and reference panel "Billing -> Usage by Tier". Also add a one-liner about export naming for analytics.

evan: Adding the link now. Pushing code samples: a tiny Python requests snippet to read the header and fall back to JSON body:

```python
# read quota header or fallback to /usage body
import requests
resp = requests.get('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY")}'})
quota_rem = resp.headers.get('x-redwood-quota-remaining')
if quota_rem is None:
    usage = requests.get('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage', headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY")}'})
    quota_rem = usage.json().get('quota', {}).get('remaining')
print('quota remaining:', quota_rem)
```

maya: Tiny nit: avoid nested `.get` chains in example; show a safe check with `if 'quota' in usage.json()` to reduce confusion for readers new to Python.

raja: Add a short section explaining rate limit responses: 429 for transient bursts (Retry-After header set) vs 403/402 for exhausted paid quota. Docs should include sample error bodies.

jen: I'll draft the 403/402 wording. Also suggest we include an inline curl showing how to inspect the `Retry-After` header quickly.

evan: Pushed curl example:

```bash
curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate | grep -i Retry-After
```

olivia: QA question: do we want to mention billing tier names verbatim in public docs? Might be better to use generic names (Free, Team, Enterprise) and link to pricing page for exact limits.

maya: Agree. Use the generic names and link to /pricing for exact token counts. Keep the table in docs conceptual.

docsbot: Lint note: broken internal anchor detected in PR #4472 (anchor: #metering-gran). Recommend using full section title instead.

evan: Fixed anchor to full section heading. Also added a short migration note for integrators: "Replace client-side token heuristics with server metrics within 30 days of enabling batching to avoid billing surprises."

raja: Approved from infra POV. :+1:

maya: Left a couple wording tweaks but approve overall.

jen: Approved. I'll add the 402 sample body snippet before merge.

evan: Merging after docs build passes. Will post a short note in #docs and #support with a link to the updated snippet. Thanks all! :rocket:
